content: El Rey de los Habanos is a premium brand of hand-rolled cigars that was created and is owned by José Pepin Garcia. It is the first premium cigar brand developed by Garcia after his arrival in the United States. These cigars are manufactured at the El Rey de los Habanos factory, located in Little Havana, Miami, Florida. The brand was introduced for national distribution in 2005. The cigars are medium to full-bodied, offering a creamy and rich flavor profile. They are classified as a Nicaraguan puro, meaning they are made entirely from Nicaraguan tobacco. The wrapper of the cigar is a Colorado Maduro, which is notable for its rich, dark color. The current product line includes four different vitolas (sizes and shapes of cigars). Initially, the cigars were sold in bundles of 25 without cellophane wrapping. However, in early 2007, the packaging was updated to semi-varnished slide-top boxes containing 23 cigars. The cigars are often referred to as the Don Pepin Red Label due to their distinctive red band. This information is corroborated by Perelman's Pocket Cyclopedia of Cigars, 2006 edition, page 215.
